item.title: Gas leak closes Sienna Parkway in Fort Bend County, officials say
item.description: Sienna Parkway is closed from Sienna Ranch Road to Steep Bank Trace until further notice, city officials said.

item.title: Texas Democrat calls for review of ICE partnerships
item.description: State Rep. Vikki Goodwin, D-Austin, has raised concerns about U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement’s tactics – including home searches, detentions of U.S. citizens and deportations – and called on Wednesday for a legislative review Texas’ cooperation with ICE and a state mandate that certain local law enforcement partner with the agency through so-called 287(g) agreements.

item.title: Attorney General Ken Paxton backs ivermectin champion’s fight against Texas Medical Board
item.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton on Thursday announced he’s taking up the case of a Houston doctor disciplined by the state’s medical board last year for trying to treat a patient with ivermectin at a hospital where she did not have privileges.

item.title: Two Democrats, two paths: Goodwin and Vélez vie for Lt. Governor nomination
item.description: As early voting begins in the March primary, Texas Democrats are weighing two very different candidates in the race for lieutenant governor. State Rep. Vikki Goodwin of Austin faces labor organizer Marcos Vélez in the March 3 primary.

item.title: What is influenza B, the type of flu now on the rise?
item.description: The number of people getting sick with influenza B has gone up for three weeks straight, now making up about a third of flu cases nationwide.

item.title: Baby food sold across the US recalled due to possible health risk
item.description: This naturally occurring substance is produced by molds that may grow in various fruits, according to the FDA.

item.title: Teenage boy shot in possible drive-by shooting in northeast Houston, HPD says
item.description: A 15-year-old boy was shot in a possible drive-by shooting in northeast Houston, police said.

item.title: No arrests made after SWAT operation in Nancy Guthrie disappearance
item.description: Nancy Guthrie, the mother of "TODAY" anchor Savannah Guthrie, was last seen on Jan. 31.

item.title: About 21,000 households without power during Saturday storms, CenterPoint says
item.description: As of 9 p.m. Saturday, over 21,000 customers were without power after the storm passed, the power company said.

item.title: Severe threat winding down, quieter Sunday ahead
item.description: Severe thunderstorms are expected to roll into SE Texas late Saturday afternoon, with a low tornado threat, but a higher chance of large hail and gusty winds, and flooding mainly north of I-10.
